blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Counsel for the prosecution Benjamin Tolosa Jr. has revealed that the Senate Impeachment Court admonished him. This happened after he gave his explanation on why he should not be cited for violation of the sub judice rule over his comments during media interviews. Tolosa made the disclosure in a press briefing on Tuesday after the 31st day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Nevertheless, he also explained that it appears the Senate Impeachment Court, at the same time, considered his explanation — because the admonition did not carry a determination that Rule 18 was violated.
